entries.09d18c4aecdce5b7: A cram school operated in the Kansai region by Create Kenkyukai Co., Ltd., which sends students to medical schools and top-tier schools, mainly in Osaka and Kyoto. The amounts are not separately disclosed.
entries.1c7d3d6de5781933: A cram school operated by Shouwa Shuppan Co., Ltd., focused on admission to top universities such as the University of Tokyo and Waseda University, and to medical school (medicine course). The amounts are not separately disclosed.
entries.1d90b9606fa00ea4: An online cram school centered in Okinawa that provides lessons to students who find it difficult to attend cram schools in urban areas. The amounts are not separately disclosed.
entries.2b8bf144cb53d2da: A business providing sales support to publishers, including subscription agency through the magazine subscription site 'Fujisan.co.jp', maruuke services that undertake delivery and customer management, and digital magazine agency. External customer sales for the fiscal year ended December 2025 were ¥5,654 million. As of December 31, 2025, the number of magazine titles handled was 13,742 and total registered users were 4,435,640.
entries.3da06b7b12488f81: A company that operates the magazine subscription site "Fujisan.co.jp" and engages in sales support for publishers and a cram school business.
entries.4f45bb359130a80b: Other contracting, merchandise sales, publishing, etc.
entries.70f254b9d5f9154f: Cram school students and their guardians
entries.81d5dc0b3558aee1: Through consolidated subsidiary magaport Co., Ltd., a service that forwards magazine data purchased from publishers to e-book sales sites and others. It processes magazine data to match the format of each digital bookstore and distributes sales proceeds to publishers. The amounts are not separately disclosed.
entries.93708601f79d8211: Through consolidated subsidiary Idea Co., Ltd., contracting for the construction and operation of merchandise sites for publishers, and through Seeds Factory Co., Ltd., publishing a watch specialist magazine, advertising, and planning, manufacturing and sale of the company's own watch brand 'OUTLINE'. The amounts are not separately disclosed.
entries.94b5abed06ff0d15: A service that forwards subscribers' orders to publishers through 'Fujisan.co.jp' and handles billing and collection of purchase payments. The company receives business fees by multiplying subscription fees by the rate set in its contracts. For some foreign magazines, the company purchases and sells the titles itself. The amounts are not separately disclosed.
entries.af85526588dd9d93: Operates cram schools through consolidated subsidiaries Shouwa Shuppan Co., Ltd., Create Education Online Co., Ltd. and Create Kenkyukai Co., Ltd. Started in July 2024. External customer sales for the fiscal year ended December 2025 were ¥160 million.
entries.d3690b9144081fdf: Headquartered in Shibuya-ku, Tokyo, the company and its group consist of the company, six consolidated subsidiaries, one non-consolidated subsidiary and one equity-method affiliate. The company engages in the magazine sales support business, centered on magazine subscriptions, and the EdTech business, which operates cram schools, and had 111 employees in the fiscal year ended December 2025. Listed on the Tokyo Stock Exchange Standard Market and the Nagoya Stock Exchange Main Market.
entries.d8d82cb96326208b: The company undertakes operations such as customer management and delivery on behalf of publishers, under 'Fujisan VCS (Value Chain Support)'. It provides support from planning to customer management, including conversion of print magazines to digital, promotion support, packing and delivery on behalf of publishers, and customer management on behalf of publishers. The amounts are not separately disclosed.
